meta.title: A very large numeric value is handled without precision loss
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the event creation screen containing the pricing sheet.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Apply a pricing template that supplies numeric price and total columns.
Add one line item for the calculation.
Render and initialize the pricing sheet columns.
Set a deterministic quantity so the expected total is the entered price.
Confirm the quantity used for the arithmetic is retained.
Enter the very large decimal value under test.
Verify the large numeric value is preserved without precision loss.
Verify the rendered total equals quantity 1 multiplied by the entered price at displayed precision.
